items.docs: This API restores the deleted resources specified in the API request. Additionally, the parent resources are also restored.

info.name: Restore all resources from Recycle Bin

items.docs: This API restores all deleted resources from the Recycle Bin.

params.name: include
params.description: Additional information related to the resources. Values allowed are: @department@ and @deletedBy@. You can pass multiple values by separating them with commas in the API request.

params.name: departmentId
params.description: ID of the department to which the deleted resources belong.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of resources to list. The default value is 10 and the maximum value supported is 100.

params.name: from
params.description: Index number, starting from which the resources must be fetched.

params.name: moduleId
params.description: ID of the module to which the deleted resources belong.

items.docs: This API lists a particular number of deleted resources, based on the limit specified.
This API permanently deletes the resources specified in the API request. Additionally, the child resources are also permanently deleted.

info.name: Delete all resources from Recycle Bin

items.docs: This API permanently deletes all resources from the Recycle Bin.
